column3: hits=$(echo "$content" | grep -oE "$pattern" 2>/dev/null) || true ==> hits=$(echo "$content" | grep -oE "$pattern" 2>/dev/null) && true
column5: every call site is `if _report_secret_matches ...`, and an if-condition suppresses errexit for the whole call including the function body - so || true and && true are indistinguishable from every reachable path. Verified by running a bare check_secrets under set -euo pipefail against both variants: byte-identical output, both reached the end of the scan. Only a direct call to this private helper outside a condition could tell them apart, and all nine call sites are conditions

configure-apps.sh sets `set -uo pipefail` and deliberately no `-e` (its own comment at :31 says why - attempt every step, report at the end), so the exit status of a failed assignment is read by nothing: in all eight cases the next statement is an `if json_extract ...` that never consults $?, and none of them is the last statement of its function. Verified by driving configure_arr_service under both variants with every non-health call returning 404 - twice, the second with the Reject ISO custom format present so the qualityprofile site behind `[[ -n $iso_cf_id ]]` is reached too: byte-identical stdout, stderr and exit status both times. Only errexit could tell them apart and nothing in this stack enables it
